# Faculty Email — Curriculum Update

Dear Colleagues,

The Curriculum Committee approved three changes for the spring 2026 semester. Each change was extensively reviewed and the committee believes the package will ensure consistency with our existing pedagogical framework.

Per the new policy, "the Committee shall ensure that any pedagogical innovation is supported by a written rationale and at least one external reviewer's assessment." This language is taken verbatim from the policy approved at the September faculty meeting.

The first change introduces a new pre-1L bridge course. The second change consolidates two upper-level seminars into a single semester-long offering. The third change adjusts the credit distribution for the externship program, working closely with Maya Calloway, Executive Director.

Please direct questions to me or to Diane Holloway, Practice Professor of Law.
